pairs.verdict: 8 of 352 same-industry pairs test as cointegrated over the last year at 5%; chance alone gives about 18, so this is no more than chance.

notes: vol: 25 of 473 stocks use the EWMA fallback (see each 'model').
var: Kupiec passed at both 95% and 99% for 27 of 49 Nifty 50 stocks (last 250 sessions, parameters fitted on earlier data only).
Last full run: 2026-11-16 (signals, track and pairs re-run on Saturdays or with --full).

Units (fractions, 0.02 = 2%): vol d1 and d5 are one standard deviation of the 1- and 5-day move, ann the same for a year; VaR is the one-day loss not exceeded on 95% / 99% of days; conformal by_sym is the 21-session return range (fraction) that held 90% of the time out of sample; signal and track numbers are mean 10-day / 21-day excess returns over the Nifty 50.
Tags: tested, cointegrated and n are exact counts; every other number is an estimate from a model.
Joint signal test asks 'does this signal beat zero excess return after allowing for testing all signals at once'; warning signals (expected to lag) are tested the same way and so do not survive.
